name: travel-team
description: Five travel-planning role agents you can invoke on demand and chain: a gem-scout (locals-only, off-path finds), a mustsee-scout (the popular-but-worth-it canon, plus an honest skip list), a bookings agent (what sells out and how far ahead it really books), a food agent (street food to book-ahead tables, grouped by neighborhood), and a concierge (merges whatever briefs exist into one dossier). All five follow the shared trip-dossier skill — one folder per trip, one brief per specialist, sourced research or nothing — so their outputs compose into a loose menu of a trip rather than an hour-by-hour itinerary.
